module: 'Other/Crash Tester' tool of the live Vehicle Editor. You choose a starting point on the terrain (wheel = rotation in 5° steps), a number of vehicles (1 to 15) and a target speed (10 to 200 km/h). 'Run Test!' spawns randomly picked cars/trucks (core_vehicles.getVehicleList, Type Car or Truck), spaced 10 m apart, handbrake released and launched at the target speed via applyClusterVelocityScaleAdd. 'Stop Test!' deletes the vehicles.
notes: Starting speed = targetSpeed / 3.6 (km/h to m/s) in the direction startDir * (0,1,0).
Minor bug: `hit = cameraMouseRayCast(...)` is assigned without `local`, so a global `hit` is created.
vehsData.done is never updated: only deletion via Stop Test! removes the vehicles.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the window (sliders, buttons) and the start markers (red triangles via debugDrawer:drawTriSolid).
